name: jira
description: Reads Jira Cloud issues, projects, and users; exposes bounded JSON direct reads; and declares approval-gated reverse ETL actions from the official Jira Cloud REST API v3 ledger (291 executable write actions, 616 operations accounted).

risk.approval: reverse ETL plan, preview, explicit approval, execute; destructive actions require --confirm destructive
